versions.subject: add ps_script verison
versions.detection:
encoded:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - ' -enc '
        - ' -EncodedCommand '
hidden:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - ' -w hidden '
        - ' -window hidden '
        - ' -windowstyle hidden '
noninteractive:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - ' -noni '
        - ' -noninteractive '
condition: all of them
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText IN ("* -enc *", "* -EncodedCommand *") ScriptBlockText IN ("* -w hidden *", "* -window hidden *", "* -windowstyle hidden *") ScriptBlockText IN ("* -noni *", "* -noninteractive *")
